children: First Real Estate Investment Trust of New Jersey reported net income attributable to common equity of $20.16 million, or $2.69 per share, for the fiscal quarter ended July 31, 2026, driven largely by a net gain on sale of the Franklin Crossing shopping center. Total real estate revenue for the quarter rose to $7.54 million, and AFFO was $1.07 million, or $0.14 per share. The company’s board approved a Plan of Voluntary Liquidation in May 2026 and declared a $0.10 per share quarterly dividend.
Total real estate revenues: $7.537 million for the fiscal quarter ended July 31, 2026 (up from $7.244 million a year earlier).
Net income attributable to common equity: $20.161 million for the fiscal quarter ended July 31, 2026 (basic and diluted EPS $2.69).
Adjusted Funds From Operations (AFFO): $1.073 million for the quarter, or $0.14 per share (AFFO for nine months: $3.805 million, $0.51 per share).
Funds From Operations (FFO): $1.218 million for the quarter, or $0.16 per share (FFO for nine months: $4.188 million, $0.56 per share).
Board-declared dividend: $0.10 per share for the third quarter; record date August 31, 2026 and payment date September 14, 2026.
Sale of Franklin Crossing shopping center closed July 8, 2026 for $27.0 million, yielding net proceeds of approximately $25.4 million and a net gain of approximately $19.8 million.
Entered into a purchase and sale agreement on May 26, 2026 to sell Westwood Plaza shopping center for $28.8 million; purchaser in due diligence with expected close in early 2027.

Adopted a Plan of Voluntary Liquidation (Board-approved May 12, 2026); special stockholder meeting scheduled for September 29, 2026 to seek approval; estimated net proceeds to stockholders projected in the range $24.44 to $30.03 per share.
Segment performance: same-property NOI increased for residential properties (quarter: ~$3.292M vs $3.137M prior year) and for commercial properties (quarter: ~$239K vs $97K prior year).

Financing actions: replaced $13M line with a $20M undrawn credit facility secured by Boulders apartment property; extended and modified loans for Preakness and Westwood properties and completed a $25.0M refinancing for a Westwood apartment building.
